generation.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((p2 (first (find-color g 2)))
                  (p4 (first (find-color g 4)))
                  (p3 (first (find-color g 3)))
                  (r2 (fst p2))
                  (c2 (snd p2))
                  (r4 (fst p4))
                  (c4 (snd p4))
                  (r3 (fst p3))
                  (c3 (snd p3)))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (cond
                        ((and (= r r2) (= c c2)) 2)
                        ((and (= r r4) (= c c4)) 4)
                        ((and (= r r3) (= c c3)) 3)
                        ((and (= r r2) (>= c (min c2 c4)) (<= c (max c2 c4))) 5)
                        ((and (= c c4) (>= r (min r2 r4)) (<= r (max r2 r4))) 5)
                        ((and (= r r4) (>= c (min c4 c3)) (<= c (max c4 c3))) 5)
                        ((and (= c c3) (>= r (min r4 r3)) (<= r (max r4 r3))) 5)
                        (else 0)))))))
